_about: SSMRadNet (Sen et al., WACV 2026, arXiv 2511.08769v2) on RADIal. Paper Table 2: Adam lr 1e-4, L2 weight decay 5e-6, batch 8, 200 epochs; detection focal + smooth-L1, freespace Jaccard; random 0.8 / 0.2 train / validation split (Sec. 3.1.2), result reported on validation. From the authors' code (AnuvabSen1/SSMRadNet 39b982b, FFTRadNet/config/ADC_config.json and loss/loss.py): seed 3, loss weights [2, 100, 100], StepLR 10 / 0.9, and regression 'smoothL1Loss', which its loss code (like ours) does not match against 'SmoothL1Loss' and so runs plain L1 -- kept as the code that produced the numbers has it. In the app, the Train page's split choice replaces splitmode and split_random.
